name: Ariel
source:
Height: 5'7"
Rank: Guardian

Ariel is a young guardian angel. Her role has always been a caring one, but don't let her gentle nature fool you, as she can be as fierce as Michael when needed.

Alongside her investigation, what will she discover when she steps out of heaven?
